validation: Independent read-only source/compile-log review; all five exports standard axioms, no reviewer build.
checks: before defines actual child-before-local-effect-before-continuation order: false descent adds no parent work, true descent adds full child.count and parent marker. Transparent wrappers add zero.

call_interval inducts every ThetaAt constructor, including errors, revert and child invocation/continuation selection. Located inner tree retains exact Theta fuel/args/full result and Cert. Invalid arbitrary paths are not used as invocation witnesses.
events_le_used identifies the selected TransactionAppendBudget receipt tree with the actual transaction event producer by Cert determinism, then consumes its complete marked-event bound.

history_lt sums marked executed events through actual receipts and natural admitted gas; distinct typed slots feed the existing finite 2^128 resource envelope. No fee iteration or caller-supplied invocation subset.
bounded_call_interval uses actual entry-before plus complete inner count; preceding prior work and the bound prior+events receipt<2^128 remain explicit inputs.
scope: This counts marked LOG0 execution work, including rollback-discarded events, rather than committed records.
Chronological prior-history linkage, protocol provenance of admission/slots, and storage invariant extraction at intervals are not yet proved by this module.
